SQUARE-01.title: Initial Discovery
text: > 0347 HOURS. The square is quiet in the way a room gets quiet when someone stops talking.
> Your target (CHEN WEI-LIN) was last seen here. The file says 12 hours. The pavement says sooner.
> In the gutter: a wallet. Too clean to be lost. Too ordinary to be planted.
> A statue stands at center—pioneer posture, modern eyes. It points nowhere. It watches everything.

SQUARE-INVEST-01.title: Paper Trail
text: > The receipts are local. The handwriting isn’t.
> Someone wanted the trail to look like tourism. It reads like routing.

CHURCH-02.title: Kaniksu Notes
text: > The basement smells like varnish, dust, and old decisions.
> In the margins: Kaniksu. A place-name, a mask, a key.
> The notes never say ‘truth.’ They say ‘stability.’

INDUSTRY-01.title: The Disguise
text: > That’s the first sign you’re inside the wrong story.
